mapper.select: SELECT p.*, o.name AS owner_name, t.name AS tenant_name FROM t_parking p LEFT JOIN t_owner o ON p.owner_id = o.id LEFT JOIN t_tenant t ON p.tenant_id = t.id WHERE p.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_parking (parking_no, area, type, size, owner_id, tenant_id, monthly_rent, status, remark, create_time) VALUES (#{parkingNo}, #{area}, #{type}, #{size}, #{ownerId}, #{tenantId}, #{monthlyRent}, #{status}, #{remark}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_parking WHERE parking_no = #{parkingNo}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rented, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN monthly_rent ELSE 0 END), 2) AS totalRent FROM t_parking
